London Police to Deploy Live Facial Recognition on Oxford Street

London's Metropolitan Police are planning to deploy live facial recognition (LFR) technology on Oxford Street, one of the city's busiest shopping areas. The technology is intended to scan shoppers' faces in a bid to identify wanted crime suspects. This deployment is proceeding despite human rights concerns that have been raised.
